project_vibe: Aerospace/Defence-Tech meets Maritime/Blue-Economy. Cinematic, technical, mysterious but confident. 'Anduril/Shield AI' feel with telemetry-inspired UI details, deep canvas, and clean oceanic accents.

hierarchy.mono_label: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-cyan-400

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay globally to add cinematic film-grain feel. Avoid plain flat black.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Deep, localized radial glows (e.g., behind the hero heading or key capabilities) using deep teal to transparent.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to maintain an aerospace/technical feel. Add 1px borders to sections to mimic telemetry panels.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24). High tension between packed technical data and wide cinematic breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use 'Bento' or asymmetric grids for features. Expose the skeleton with 1px borders (border-collapse style) for the technical look.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Max-w-7xl for content, but allow abstract SVGs or background images to bleed full width.

motion_and_interactions.global: Smooth scrolling (Lenis style). Staggered text reveals.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Technical hover: borders brighten, mono labels glitch or type out, subtle crosshair or bracket indicators appear around cards.
motion_and_interactions.background_motion: Slow, subtle CSS or SVG animation mimicking gentle waves or sweeping radar/horizon lines.

icons.style: Technical, 1px stroke, cyan or white color.
icons.usage: Use icons sparingly; rely more on typography and SVG telemetry accents.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, 1px solid border, transparent or glass background, text changes color or background fills on hover. Add a tiny mono label inside the button for extreme tech vibe.
components.cards: Flat, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: subtle shadow, border turns cyan, slight lift.
components.inputs: Shadcn based, sharp edges, dark background, cyan focus ring.
components.data_testids: MANDATORY on all buttons, forms, and interactive cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page scrolling teaser in React using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Do NOT use default Inter font. Use Instrument Serif for headings and JetBrains Mono for accents.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts and grids, rely on Shadcn only for form elements (inputs, selects, buttons).
Create custom SVG illustrations using code to represent the 'WIG craft silhouette' and telemetry data. Do not use emojis.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, select triggers, and the submit button, e.g., data-testid='contact-name-input'.
Create a noise overlay effect using a fixed div with pointer-events-none and a repeating background image or SVG filter.
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and hover effects if possible, or standard Tailwind transitions.
Ensure the hero overlay is dark enough to make the white serif text completely legible (WCAG AA).
DO NOT reveal any financials, stage costs, competitor tables, or partner names. Only use provided public text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
